lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 10 distinct vertical white lines. Spacing is relatively uniform across the central torso (lines 3-8) with increased frequency/narrower gaps approaching the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 1 and 2 at the anterior shoulder and lines 9 and 10 at the posterior haunch are abbreviated, terminating before reaching the ventral midline. Line 10 appears as a series of three vertically aligned dashes.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low density. One primary high-contrast circular spot on the lateral upper hind limb, with 2-3 smaller, lower-contrast spots located inferiorly on the mid-thigh.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A set of three spots on the posterior haunch align to form a diagonal geometric vector descending toward the tarsal joint.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Spiraled lyrate curvature; horns emerge dorsally with a lateral flare before curving medially and posteriorly toward the tips. The spiral twist completes approximately one full rotation from base to apex.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Estimated 2.8:1 ratio between the distance of the two terminal horn tips relative to the pixel width of the right horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Light-colored ivory tipping accounts for approximately 15% of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron between the eyes; two distinct white spots on the muzzle; white dorsal mane/crest; long dark hair fringe along the throat and belly; and high-contrast tan/ochre coloration on the lower limbs starting at the carpus/tarsus.
